Base stats follow the race and cannot be edited. Gear, enchants, talents, consumables and buffs are added on top; the Extra fields are for bonuses nothing else covers. Stats in the sidebar shows the totals the sim uses; hover a value to see how much comes from base, talents, gear, consumables and buffs.

Click a talent to add a point. Right-click, Shift-click or the − button removes one. Hover a talent for its name and effect; the tooltip says when a talent is not modelled in the sim. Tiers, ranks and prerequisites come from community talent listings (November 2026); some column positions are approximated.

      Base values come from guides published in November 2026 (tagged guide), Forever tooltips read from Wowhead data (tooltip), values fitted to two wowsims runs (calibrated), Classic 1.12 (classic) or estimates (guess). Raids have not opened yet, so there are no level 63 boss logs to calibrate against. Absolute DPS numbers can therefore differ from other sims. Comparisons between rotations and stats are more reliable than the absolute numbers.
